# WorldScript API

World scripts are trusted JavaScript modules. Run them only in trusted local workspaces.

## Module Shape

```js
export default {
  setupScene(api) {
    api.initialize({
      title: 'World Title',
      description: 'Short scene description.',
      entities: []
    }, { merge: false, spawnEntities: true });
  }
};
```

## API Methods

Generated from `engine/src/automation/worldScript.ts`.

- `api.initialize(definition: any, options?: Record<string, any>)`
- `api.spawn(ref: any, overrides?: Record<string, any>)`
- `api.getModule(name: string)`
- `api.registerArchetype(name: string, definition: any, builtIn = false)`
- `api.registerRuntimeModuleType(definition: any)`
- `api.unregisterRuntimeModuleType(moduleName: string, typeName: string)`
- `api.registerRuntimeModuleInstance(moduleName: string, instanceName: string, definition: any)`
- `api.unregisterRuntimeModuleInstance(moduleName: string, instanceName: string)`

Use `api.initialize(definition, { merge: false, spawnEntities: true })` for whole-world creation. Use `api.spawn` and `api.registerArchetype` for procedural construction after initialization.

## Valid Box Helper

```js
function boxPart(lengthX, lengthY, lengthZ, color) {
  return {
    geometry: { type: 'box', params: { lengthX, lengthY, lengthZ } },
    material: { type: 'solid', params: { color, roughness: 0.8 } }
  };
}

function boxEntity(name, x, y, z, lengthX, lengthY, lengthZ, color = '#7b8794') {
  return {
    Info: { name },
    Transform: { x, y, z },
    Body: { type: 'composite', params: { parts: [boxPart(lengthX, lengthY, lengthZ, color)] } },
    MotionSource: { type: 'static', params: {} }
  };
}
```

Do not use shorthand like `Body: { type: 'box', size: ... }`. Gizmo entity bodies use composite bodies with primitive parts:

```js
{
  Info: { name: 'Platform' },
  Transform: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
  Body: {
    type: 'composite',
    params: {
      parts: [
        {
          geometry: { type: 'box', params: { lengthX: 8, lengthY: 0.5, lengthZ: 8 } },
          material: { type: 'solid', params: { color: '#6f7f8f' } }
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  MotionSource: { type: 'static', params: {} }
}
```

## Run And Validate

```bash
gizmo run-world-script ./world.world.js --world ./world.json --validate
```

For MCP-enabled script execution, the session must be started with `--allow-world-scripts`.
